title: The Signal House
objective: Relight the beacon within 24 turns; optional preparation earns a stronger rescue.

jetty.title: Storm Jetty
jetty.text: Rain needles the water. A signal tower overlooks the house. Take the lantern if it remains; secure the line before entering if you want the boat to hold while you work.

keeper_room.title: Keeper's Room
keeper_room.text: Use what remains. Hand lantern will need oil before climbing unless already filled. Read remaining clues. Signal the boat first if needed; check radio if needed before taking the oil; after the lantern is filled, only with time, use the repaired stair once current is restored and supplies are ready. If unsecured: read the log, take oil, then return to secure the mooring before studying tide.

workshop.title: Workshop
workshop.text: If the fuse remains uninstalled, install it before leaving; the service ladder opens. If you already carry both lantern and oil, install the fuse instead of backtracking; after installation, climb the service ladder; return only for missing supplies or unfinished keeper-room prep. Missing supplies? Emergency release returns to the keeper's room.

tower.title: Lantern Room
tower.text: Aligned by hand if needed; charred wick can be trimmed before lighting the beacon if needed. Log and tide chart are recorded; tower relay can confirm the radio channel after the lantern is filled if needed. Finish any trim or alignment before spending a turn to wait. Last turn: light now. Several lighting choices; most preparation: sheltered confirmed-channel rescue/secured-boat tuned rescue at tide/horn-timed rescue/marked-tide rescue/perfectly timed/fully prepared. Bar shutters: sheltered finish

take_lantern.label: Take the brass lantern
take_lantern.text: You take the lantern from a hook; secure the mooring line before entering when able; signal the boat from the keeper's room.

secure_mooring.label: Secure the supply boat's mooring
secure_mooring.text: Mooring secure—opening the way to a stronger rescue. Choose: signal it from the keeper's room for a confirmed channel, or keep the mooring secured and light for the boat directly.

effects.remember: The supply boat's mooring is secure.

enter_house.label: Enter the keeper's house
enter_house.text: Door opens. If mooring unsecured, boat may not hold; once secure, boat holds. If the lantern is still outside, return to the jetty for it.

leave_island.label: Abandon the station
leave_island.text: You wave the waiting boat on; abandoning the dark station.

read_log.label: Read the wall log
read_log.text: Replace the fuse, fill the hand lantern, then touch its flame to the beacon. The keeper's sequence can strengthen the rescue.

effects.remember: Log: replace the fuse; fill the lantern; light the beacon.

study_tide_chart.label: Study the tide chart
study_tide_chart.text: Safe window for a stronger rescue: light the beacon before the next high tide.

effects.remember: Tide chart: light the beacon before the next high tide.

signal_boat.label: Signal the secured boat to hold position
signal_boat.text: Ring the bell; supply boat holds position. If needed, read the log and tide chart before checking the storm radio.

wind_chronometer.label: Wind the tower chronometer (costs one turn; optional precision prep)
wind_chronometer.text: You wind the brass chronometer against the tide chart before climbing. Its chime can time the cleanest beam.

check_storm_radio.label: Check the storm radio before taking oil (costs one turn)
check_storm_radio.text: The channel is clear; the supply boat holds position. This confirmed channel can guide the strongest rescue.

take_oil.label: Take the oil flask
take_oil.text: You take the sealed oil flask; it belongs in the hand lantern before climbing.

go_jetty.label: Return to the jetty for the missing lantern
go_jetty.text: You return to the jetty to fetch the missing lantern before re-entering.

return_for_mooring.label: Return—secure the mooring before tide study; recovery remains open afterward
return_for_mooring.text: Return to the jetty after reading the log; secure the supply boat's mooring, then re-enter the keeper's house.

effects.remember: Mooring recovery used; boat safety restored.

go_workshop.label: Enter the workshop
go_workshop.text: If current is not restored, install the switchboard fuse to restore tower power; otherwise return to the keeper's room for missing supplies.

climb_tower.label: Climb the unpowered stair (repair first is faster; fill after repair to keep chronometer timing; wind the tower chronometer before early fill)
climb_tower.text: Unpowered stair: switchboard still needs repair below. Fill the lantern if you have oil; return to install the fuse. Chronometer-timed rescue: wind it before this early fill; repair return closes that option.

climb_repaired_stairs.label: Climb to the lantern room
climb_repaired_stairs.text: Repaired stair to lantern room; fill the lantern if it still holds oil, then continue the beacon work above.

take_fuse.label: Take the ceramic fuse
take_fuse.text: You take the dry fuse from the drawer; install it in the switchboard before leaving.

install_fuse.label: Install the fuse in the switchboard
install_fuse.text: The fuse seats with a clean click. Current reaches the tower; climb the service ladder.

climb_service_ladder.label: Climb the service ladder to the tower
climb_service_ladder.text: Current restored; climb the service ladder to the tower; return below if supplies are missing: carry the lantern and oil, or fill the lantern first.

return_keeper_from_workshop.label: Return to the keeper's room
return_keeper_from_workshop.text: Tower work remains ahead—workshop stays behind. If the fuse is already installed—service ladder is done—take oil if needed; use repaired stair—otherwise return to the workshop to take and install it.

return_keeper_after_repair.label: Use the emergency release to fetch missing supplies
return_keeper_after_repair.text: Emergency release sends you to the keeper's room. Take missing oil if needed; jetty return too if lantern's gone; use repaired stair. Moored boat can still be rescued.

effects.remember: Emergency supply route: recover missing supplies, then use the repaired stair.

fill_lantern.label: Fill the lantern with oil
fill_lantern.text: Small flame holds steady. If repair remains (switchboard fuse), return below; else trim the wick or align the beacon lens before lighting the beacon.

effects.remember: Hand lantern filled; beacon remains dark.

trim_wick.label: Trim wick; tune before last turn
trim_wick.text: Clean, steady flame; align the beacon lens before lighting the beacon if it is not already aligned.

effects.remember: Wick trimmed for a clean beam.

align_lens.label: Align lens; tune by last turn
align_lens.text: Beam will hold true. If it is not already trimmed, trim the wick before lighting the beacon.

effects.remember: The beacon lens is aligned with the channel.

light_beacon.label: Light the storm beacon
light_beacon.text: The great lens catches. A white beam cuts across the storm.

light_moored_beacon.label: Light the beacon for the secured boat
light_moored_beacon.text: The beacon catches; the secured mooring holds. A white beam cuts through the storm as the boat turns safely toward the station.

light_signaled_beacon.label: Light the beacon for the waiting boat
light_signaled_beacon.text: The beacon catches and the waiting boat answers with three bright horn blasts across the storm.

light_recovered_beacon.label: Light the beacon after the emergency recovery
light_recovered_beacon.text: Emergency recovery pays off: the beacon catches. The waiting boat answers; the secured mooring carries the rescue through the storm.

light_recovered_tuned_beacon.label: Light the tuned beacon after recovery
light_recovered_tuned_beacon.text: The recovered lantern burns cleanly through the aligned lens. The waiting boat answers; secured mooring carries the rescue through the storm.

light_trimmed_beacon.label: Light the storm beacon with the clean flame
light_trimmed_beacon.text: The clean flame catches the great lens. A bright beam cuts across the storm.

light_aligned_beacon.label: Light the aligned storm beacon
light_aligned_beacon.text: The aligned lens catches the flame. A true white beam cuts across the storm and holds on the channel.

light_aligned_trimmed_beacon.label: Light the aligned beacon with the clean flame
light_aligned_trimmed_beacon.text: The aligned lens catches the clean flame. A true white beam cuts across the storm and holds on the channel.

light_moored_tide_beacon.label: Light the beacon on the marked tide
light_moored_tide_beacon.text: The marked tide guides the secured boat. The beacon cuts through the storm; the mooring holds. The boat turns safely toward the station.

light_moored_aligned_trimmed_beacon.label: Light the tuned beacon for the secured boat
light_moored_aligned_trimmed_beacon.text: Secured mooring steadies the rescue; the aligned lens catches the clean flame. The true beam holds across the storm; the boat turns safely toward the station.

light_moored_tide_tuned_beacon.label: Light the marked-tide tuned beacon
light_moored_tide_tuned_beacon.text: The marked tide meets the tuned lens; the secured mooring holds. A clean beam cuts across the storm; the boat turns safely toward the station.

light_all_ready_beacon.label: Light the tuned beacon without timing bonus (valid fallback rescue; wait for horn bonus when available; tuned prepared channel still earns a stronger rescue)
light_all_ready_beacon.text: The aligned lens catches the clean flame. Three bright horn blasts answer; the true beam guides the waiting boat into the channel.

light_timed_beacon.label: Light the perfectly timed beacon for the waiting boat
light_timed_beacon.text: Perfect tide: the aligned lens catches the clean flame. Three bright horn blasts answer. The waiting boat clears the channel before it turns.

light_horn_timed_beacon.label: Light the horn-timed beacon for the waiting boat
light_horn_timed_beacon.text: The next horn sounds as the aligned lens catches the clean flame. The waiting boat answers before the channel turns.

light_rescue_beacon.label: Light the rescue beacon on the marked tide
light_rescue_beacon.text: The keeper's sequence meets the tide mark: the clean flame fills the aligned lens. The waiting boat answers and turns safely into the channel.

light_radio_rescue_beacon.label: Light the confirmed-channel rescue beacon
light_radio_rescue_beacon.text: Radio confirms a clear channel with the keeper's sequence and tide mark. The clean flame fills the aligned lens. The waiting boat turns safely into the channel.

light_sheltered_radio_beacon.label: Light the sheltered confirmed-channel beacon
light_sheltered_radio_beacon.text: Clear channel; barred shutters hush gusts. Three bright horn blasts answer; the clean flame fills the aligned lens. The waiting boat turns safely into the channel.

light_chronometer_beacon.label: Light the chronometer-timed rescue beacon
light_chronometer_beacon.text: Chronometer chimes on the marked tide. Three bright horn blasts answer; the clean flame fills the aligned lens. The waiting boat turns safely into the channel.

close_storm_shutters.label: Optional: close storm shutters (bar them; costs one turn; never on the last turn; finish trim/alignment first)
close_storm_shutters.text: Bar storm shutters. Finish remaining trim or alignment before another turn; the beam holds through rescue.

effects.remember: Storm shutters barred for a steady beam.

light_sheltered_chronometer_beacon.label: Light the sheltered chronometer rescue beacon
light_sheltered_chronometer_beacon.text: Barred shutters hush gusts as the chronometer chimes on the marked tide. The clean flame fills the aligned lens. The waiting boat turns safely into the channel.

wait_for_horn.label: Wait after fill/after beam tuning: timing bonus; never on the last turn; one turn remaining: light now
wait_for_horn.text: Spend one turn; horn earns a small rescue bonus; can unlock the horn-timed finish when the tide mark is recorded without the wall log. With the log, marked-tide rescue fallback. Finish any trim or alignment before lighting if needed; remaining turn matters. Never wait on the last turn. Light next turn.

effects.remember: You waited through one boat horn.

check_tower_radio.label: Check the tower relay for a clear channel (tune first; costs one turn; before last turn only; never on last turn)
check_tower_radio.text: Channel is clear. Finish beam tuning if needed; use confirmed-channel rescue beacon. Check before the last turn; costs a turn. Bar storm shutters before this check if needed: close for a sheltered finish.

effects.remember: The coast station confirms the channel is clear.

return_keeper_from_tower.label: Descend to fetch missing oil or lantern
return_keeper_from_tower.text: Return for missing oil; if the lantern is missing too, collect both before returning to the tower. Moored boat can still be rescued.

effects.remember: Emergency supply route: recover missing supplies, then use the repaired stair.

return_keeper_after_fill.label: Descend: the switchboard still needs repair
return_keeper_after_fill.text: Pause the lantern work while the switchboard is repaired below. Return to the workshop, install the fuse, climb again.

return_keeper_for_lantern.label: Descend to fetch missing lantern or oil
return_keeper_for_lantern.text: Return to the jetty; collect the missing lantern. Take the oil too if needed before climbing again. A moored boat can still be rescued.

effects.remember: Emergency supply route: recover missing supplies, then use the repaired stair.

beacon.title: Beacon Relit
beacon.text: The beacon burns through the rain. The island has a keeper again.

left.title: Station Abandoned
left.text: The unlit tower vanishes behind rain as the boat turns for the mainland.

timeout.title: Too Late
timeout.text: The final storm window closes before you light the beacon. The station remains dark; leave one turn for the final light.
